_comment: Seed manifest for the kanboard micro-benchmark target (plan-004 U4, R22). Seeding is API-driven: benchmark.py drives Kanboard's JSON-RPC API (/jsonrpc.php, HTTP basic admin/admin) — createProject per project, createTask per task (default column). The frozen micro-benchmark slice's hand-verified verdicts are defined against THIS post-seed state, so changing it is a deliberate, recorded apparatus migration, not an edit. Scoped to the benchmark slice's feature areas (projects, tasks, board columns, search); the full registry is allowed to grow later (R22).
